item.title: Harrogate Christmas Parade
item.description: The City of Harrogate’s annual Christmas Parade was held on Saturday as cars and spectators lined Highway 63 between Arthur Road and the LMU park. Vendors and food trucks were also set up in the City Hall parking lot as part of the city’s Christmas Village.
